english_policy.notes.2: A qualifying master GPA is an alternative to the undergraduate last-60-credit GPA requirement. That alternative is not captured by the bachelor-only profile; below-threshold applicants require manual review rather than automatic rejection.
english_policy.notes.3: English tests must be recent relative to anticipated enrollment, with waiver and conditional-score pathways. The current assessment-date checker cannot represent that entire policy, so English eligibility remains unknown.

fact_summary: UW-1241 requires a recognized bachelor qualification and specifies an undergraduate last-60-credit GPA or a qualifying master GPA. English score age is anchored to enrollment, with alternatives requiring manual review.
